description: This file defines the EmailConfigurationAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for getting and updating email configuration settings within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving current configuration, validating input data, and saving configuration changes, along with sending test emails.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing email configuration settings in OrangeHRM, supporting retrieval and update operations, including validation and test email functionality.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve current email configuration settings, returning default values if none exist.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT request to update email configuration settings, with optional test email sending and validation.

methods.name: saveEmailConfigurationInfo
methods.description: Creates or updates the email configuration object based on request data and persists it.

methods.name: setEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Sets properties of the EmailConfiguration object from request parameters.
